# Task
Task: ajcr-cert-r2
Title: Execute R2: widen DivFamZar to arbitrary affine-open pieces
Project(s) — work across all of them:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild at MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild
References: roadmap=AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate,AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.cert-collapse,AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.swallow-adapt,AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.cert-assemble,AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.away-kerspan,AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr; inbox=I-0492,I-0346,I-0494,I-0495

EXECUTE THE HUMAN DECISION OF 2026-07-28 (protection I-0492, inbox I-0346, roadmap AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate): DivFamZar is widened so its cover pieces are ARBITRARY AFFINE OPENS rather than basic opens of a fixed pair of pinned P1 charts. The certificate lane is unblocked and this is the lane that unblocks everything downstream. READ I-0492 AND I-0346 FIRST, then informal/spec-dd-r.md ADDENDUM 3 and 4.

THE JUSTIFICATION TO USE, NOT RE-DERIVE: supp D is finite over R, hence lies in a single affine open of C x_k Spec R (Stacks 0B8B). ADDENDUM 4 carries the argument.

THE STRUCTURAL MOVE, and it is the whole content of the task: THE CHART-WISE PARTITIONS OF UNITY HAVE TO GO. Per-piece swallow-or-miss needs only openness (DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean:98 uses only openness); it is the partitions that upgrade inside one piece to inside one chart. Consumers WILL break — repair them deliberately. Do not smuggle the old typing back in by typing pieces INTO the charts: DivisorFamily.lean:166/168/186 (h0 into V0, h1 into V1, pieces := Sum.elim (basicOpen . h0) (basicOpen . h1)) is exactly the pattern that made the previously-refuted joint-cover option vacuous, and changing partition FIELDS cannot change where the pieces LIVE.

TWO OBLIGATIONS THE WIDENING RELOCATES RATHER THAN REMOVES. Discharge both explicitly; neither may hide inside a LocalEquations: (i) fibrewise-finite support, which must come from the seeds own degree data and is NOT implied by anything a LocalEquations carries; (ii) whatever the old fixed-pair confinement was silently supplying to the certificate clauses.

THEN LAND THE CONSUMER CHAIN, in the order the roadmap already ranks it: cert-collapse (read its node first — the original free claim was REFUTED by work-reviewer at I-0340; do not re-derive it), swallow-adapt (coarse chart-pair adaptation is LANDED; the chart-principality datum remains), cert-assemble (compose into isLocallyCertified_of_forall_prime_exists_certified_adaptation, DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean:162, and its DivFamZar packaging), and away-kerspan (BLOCKED and likely an artifact — do NOT grind it before cert-collapse is tried; its node says so).

BINDING PROHIBITIONS, from the decision:
 * DO NOT build the GL_2(k) / Aut(P1) action on P1 (leaf ...p1-aut is deprioritised, priority low). No consumer against it.
 * Chart-avoid is NO. The counterexample is FIELD-INDEPENDENT, so enlarging the field is not an escape.
 * NO repair keeping the pieces inside preimages of a FIXED PAIR of P1 points can work. The joint-cover variant is refuted (leaf ...joint-cover, rejected) — do not retry it.
 * The landed finite-field-avoid work (cardinality e602378af, support-degree d6c67f41d) is valid mathematics; it stops being the route but is not to be deleted.

CONCURRENCY IS BINDING HERE. Four AJCR teams run at once. Follow informal/protocol-concurrent-lanes.md exactly: private-index compare-and-swap commits (never a bare git commit against the ledger), and the mkdir lake mutex at /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock — it is a DIRECTORY lock, never flock it.

COORDINATION. You are the upstream of ajcr-divrep and ajcr-charts. FREEZE the widened DivFamZar/FinCoverData shapes as early as you honestly can and announce them on the AJCR conversation thread; both downstream teams are blocked on the shape, not the proofs. Announce every shape change immediately. Never edit files outside Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild.

This is a headless, one-shot session: work the task's REAL objective as far
as you genuinely can, committing progress as you go, then finish with the
brief final report the skill specifies.
